summary: Mic noise suppression made to work in the EXE and reworked. Two silent bugs: RNNoise never loaded in prod (pyrnnoise's package init imports audiolab/av, never bundled) so the Light engine passed the raw mic through while logging a warning per audio block; and DeepFilterNet's strength slider drove the model's atten_lim_db, which comb-filters the voice at any finite limit (GUI default 85 = 0.3 dB SI-SDR on clean speech). Now: rnnoise.dll bound directly via ctypes, strength = delay-compensated wet/dry, engines built off-thread with a one-shot fallback chain and a live status line, denoising on a dedicated Pro-Audio worker thread, plus three new options (Max = DFN + lsnr residual gate, Classic = MCRA/Wiener spectral with no AI, Gate only) and an 80 Hz low-cut. Objective A/B on a real voice clip: DFN +9 dB SI-SDR on white noise, +14.6 on keyboard clicks.

Two agents applied the converged style spec (28/32/24/36 px tiers, tokens, green=confirm, de-emoji'd checkboxes, status bar overflow, device-px tab emoji/thumbnails/QR/picker/editor).
